name: 説明と所在地と訂正導線を備える施設詳細
prompt: Create one compact tall Japanese Lighthouse facility-detail panel, white #FFFFFF throughout. Japanese mock is secondary for copy/layout; ORIGINAL controls fine glyph anatomy and visible state. Header: back chevron, '代々木の公園' Regular14/24, original share-tray/up-arrow and three horizontal dots at right (mock plain right arrow is wrong). Tabs restore original five categories translated '施設一覧' / '口コミ' / '写真' / '最新情報' / '詳細'; ONLY 詳細 selected green with short underline, others gray Regular14; original About selected, mock 概要 selection wrong. Below '施設の詳細' Bold20/28, description exact 'ピクニックや散歩を楽しみながら、地域の人が集まる屋外の公園です。' Regular14/24 gray, wrap naturally without clipping. Then FIVE detail rows, neutral thin dividers, small supporting slate#526173 icons WITHOUT mint bubbles, body Regular14/metaRegular12: (1) original outlined long teardrop pin with SOLID central dot, text '東京都渋谷区代々木' / '住所と位置情報'; (2) original outlined clock, minute up/hour down-right, text green '営業中' plus dark '・22:00まで', meta '営業時間を確認', original small down-V after hours; (3) original storefront with striped/sloped awning, not house, text '公園内の施設' / '交流広場・運動場'; (4) original SOLID globe with white continent cutouts, not document or latitude-grid, text '公式サイト' / '施設の案内を見る'; (5) original plus-code mark: central filled square with FOUR separate small circular dots at north/south/east/west (not a plus or sliders), text '位置コード' / '代々木・東京都渋谷区', small circled lowercase i at far right. Then THREE correction rows separated: outlined diagonal pencil original, '情報の修正を提案'; original SOLID shield with white check, 'この施設の管理者ですか'; original FILLED telephone receiver and exact '電話番号を追加' BOTH MUTED GRAY as source, not bright enabled styling/ID-card. White surfaces and quiet consistent 18px utility glyphs relative14px text, preserve original anatomy/stroke, never oversized. Bottom separated action bar from distinct original supporting source: forest-green circular route button contains WHITE DIAMOND with GREEN right-angled BENT TURN-RIGHT arrow inside (NOT paper plane or navigation dart); white neutral-outlined pills '保存' with outline bookmark, '共有' with original share tray/up-arrow, '公式' with solid globe/white continents. Labels Regular14, supporting icons slate, primary route uses restrained135deg #174C36/#1F6444/#2D8F5E gradient. No broad mint, no card shadows, all row text Regular except one section heading, no invented pictures or data, no booking action. Preserve all8 rows, source selection/muted state and full bottom bar. Fit complete content in compact native-width tall panel, keep lower controls unclipped. Static Japanese examples only, not current facts or working app.
reviewNotes: All5tabs/About-detail selection, eight source glyph rows, muted phone-add state and distinct diamond-bent-turn/bookmark/share/globe action bar restored. Japanese text complete and utility slate coherent. Selected 詳細 tab visibly Bold vs Regular tab role; one targeted typography correction needed, preserve all anatomy/states/layout.
